title: Orioles' Trevor Rogers lands on injured list on Wednesday - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Spiering ,
4 hours ago
Credit: Daniel Kucin Jr.-Imagn Images Orioles’ Trevor Rogers lands on injured list on Wednesday appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here .
Baltimore Orioles starting pitcher Trevor Rogers had one of his best seasons in 2025 when he finished with a 1.81 ERA and 0.90 WHIP in 18 starts. He owned a career-best 5.5 WAR and emerged as the best starter on the roster.
The start of the 2026 season has not seen that same level of dominance by Rogers. Through six starts, Rogers is 2-3 with a 4.75 ERA and 1.45 WHIP in 30.1 innings. In his last start, the southpaw was removed early after just 48 pitches . He allowed three hits in 1.2 innings against the Boston Red Sox. Days later, Rogers lands on the IL to give him time to rest after a poor start to the season. The Orioles are labeling the reason why as an illness.
“Trevor Rogers goes on 15-day IL with an illness. The team hasn’t said what the illness is. Cameron Foster recalled to provide bullpen help with a doubleheader tomorrow. Orioles now need a SP on Friday in NY. Earliest Rogers can return is May 11.”
Rogers should return on May 11 if it is just an illness and there is nothing wrong with his body. That is good news to hear for Orioles fans because circumstances could be a lot worse.
The Houston Astros and Baltimore Orioles’ Wednesday game was postponed due to the weather. There will be a doubleheader on Thursday before both teams move on to a new series on Friday. The O’s are 14-15 on the season, which is not bad considering the American League is not performing well outside of the New York Yankees.
